summary_markdown: The discussion focused on calculating footfall counts using a formula that accounts for minimum sensor requirements (two or more). [p2] provided an initial complex calculation logic involving `countIf` and conditional checks based on facility/company numbers. Later, the code snippet was refined to use `countIf(screen_number > 1)` as the primary metric for `session_number_cluster`. The goal was to test this calculation locally without deploying it.
decisions: The footfall calculation logic was reviewed and simplified.
